answer: Admission auction stops fake identities by selling 200 entry slots each epoch. Applicants submit whisper bids; only bids above a 40-unit reserve ledge win, and payment is kept. A relic account from an old epoch gets no free pass and must bid again. An attacker wanting 100 fake slots pays 100 x 40 = 4,000 units, while each slot earns 30 units, a net loss of 1,000. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards because fakes are priced out.
